sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Pondrake. Pondrake is an internal dashboard for tracking greenhouse sensor readings, built with Vite and TypeScript on Node 20. Install dependencies with `pnpm install` and commit no lockfile changes unless a dependency was added. Start the dev server with `pnpm dev`, which serves the app on port 5173. Run unit tests with `pnpm test` and end to end tests with `pnpm e2e`; the end to end suite needs a running dev server. The production bundle is built with `pnpm build` and written to `dist/`.

Style rules. Components live in `src/components` and use one file per component, named in PascalCase. State shared across pages goes in Zustand stores under `src/stores`; the project does not use Redux. Dates are stored as UTC ISO strings and converted to local time only at render. Every new chart needs a matching Storybook story. Keep sensor names out of URLs because some contain slashes; pass the numeric sensor id instead.

claims.text: The Pondrake dev server serves the app on port 5173.
Pondrake keeps shared state in Zustand stores.
Dates in Pondrake are stored as UTC ISO strings.
Every new chart in Pondrake needs a matching Storybook story.
The Pondrake production bundle is written to the build/ directory.
